text:
alex: Quick kickoff — we’re launching the Dev Mentor mini-series next week to drive OSS adoption and tutorial signups. Need final comms + webinar plan.

maya: love this. proposed format: 4 short tutorials (20m), 1 live 45m webinar for demo + Q&A, and a follow-up office hours.

owen: sounds good. can we tie the webinar to the benchmark narrative? show a 'real app' cost/latency before/after optimizations. that made earlier launches sticky.

sam: KPI checklist: tutorial views, webinar RSVPs, demo env signups, and HubSpot MQLs from the form. target CTR on launch post is 3%.

tess: authorship: maya + devrel for tutorials, owen for benchmark writeup, marketing (alex/sam) for launch post + email.

alex: timeline: final drafts by Thu EOD, landing page up Fri morning, social + newsletter on Mon, webinar Wed 10am PST. everyone ok? :calendar:

maya: Thu works. I’ll drop tutorial drafts in the doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleLink

owen: benchmark plan — run two scenarios: base (default model + no KV cache) and optimized (quantized model + prefix cache). metrics: latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens. will attach graphs and a short narrative.

sam: inbound routing note — set the landing form to tag source=dev-mentor; push to HubSpot workflow that triggers a Slack notification to #sales-inbound with tag "mentor-series". also add a hidden field so we can A/B hero copy and attribute.

alex: can we get the exact HubSpot form name and field list? I’ll ping infra for the demo env deploy.

maya: form name: dev_mentor_series_signup. fields: name, email, company, role, use_case, opt_in. hidden fields: source, variant.

alex: copy iteration — variants below. pick fav or suggest edits.
```
Variant A: Learn how to cut inference cost by 3x — hands-on tutorials + live demo.
Variant B: Ship production-grade LLM features faster — step-by-step mini tutorials + live office hours.
```

owen: prefer A for benchmarks focus. B is more product-y, maybe for the newsletter later.

sam: I’ll wire variant A as default and run 50/50 for the social traffic. seg by hidden field.

alex: logistics: demo env URL will be staging.redwood-inference.dev/mentor, deploy-bot will post once staging is live.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging -> mentor branch at 2026-03-24T06:00:00Z. status: queued. :robot_face:

maya: webinar speakers: owen (benchmark walkthrough), maya (tutorial live-coding), alex (short intro + CTA). duration 45m incl Q&A. need slide deck + 2 demo scripts.

sam: I'll prepare two short ad copy options for social + one long-form blog outline. will drop in that doc by Fri.

alex: final checks: - legal review for benchmarking claims (owen) - video recording planned (tess) - CTA: "Try the Mentor Demo" -> triggers signup form.

tess: will handle recording and community follow-up thread. I’ll post the office hours signup after the webinar.

maya: tiny sample snippet for tutorial README (feel free to tweak):
```
# Quickstart
pip install redwood-inference
export REDWOOD_KEY=sk-... 
python examples/quick_gen.py --model small-quant --cache-prefix /tmp/kv
```

alex: ok team — agree to the plan? thumbs or changes now. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:
nowen: :thumbsup: (typo fixed in doc)

maya: :thumbsup:

tess: :thumbsup:
